column1: # THE BYTE-FREEZE REGISTRY.  Data, not prose.  Read by tests/byte-freeze.rs.
# AGENTS.md rule 47: record the WHOLE invocation beside every hash -- the flags
# you left at their default AND the environment you ran it in.  A hash without
# its command is not a weak record, it is not a record at all.  The test does not
# merely *check* the rows against a command written somewhere else -- it BUILDS
# the command and the environment out of the row, so the hash and the invocation
# cannot drift apart, and one milestone's flag can never be spliced onto another
# milestone's command.  That splice is fact 1379: it cost a 1.9-hour
# investigation into a regression that had not happened.
# The environment columns are not theoretical rigour.  An earlier draft of rule
# 47 bound only "directory, --limit and --gate by value" -- all CLI flags -- and
# within two hours a freeze was found that reproduces EXACTLY but only under
# STREHL_ALIGN=0, a value that appeared nowhere in its record.  Three false
# breaks in one session came from this one root cause: `bee-3-cpl` lost --gate,
# `coffee-bean` lost STREHL_ALIGN.
# TAB-separated.  Blank lines and lines beginning with `#` are ignored.  The
# header row is checked verbatim, so renaming or reordering a column fails loudly
# instead of silently shifting every field one to the left.
# COLUMNS
#   id              kebab-case, unique.  Names the invocation, not the milestone.
#   stack           leaf directory under the capture library (see `capture_library`
#                   in byte-freeze.rs; $STREHL_CAPTURES overrides).  A leaf, never
#                   a path: the library root is machine-local and belongs in an
#                   environment variable, not in a frozen record.
#   frames          FIRST..LAST that --limit actually selects, VERIFIED against the
#                   directory before anything is rendered.  "limit 20" is not
#                   reproducible without knowing which twenty: --limit takes a
#                   PREFIX in name order, so one file added to the front of a
#                   bracket reframes every freeze on it and the hash moves for a
#                   reason that has nothing to do with the renderer.
#   limit           --limit, always explicit.
#   gate            --gate, always explicit AND ALWAYS BY VALUE.  `default` is a
#                   rejected value: DEFAULT_GATE moved once already and the
#                   absence of this one flag is the whole of fact 1379.
#   srgb            yes|no -- whether --srgb is passed.
#   -- the environment.  `unset` is a VALUE, spelled out, never an empty field:
#      the defect rule 47 names is that a reader cannot tell a default from an
#      omission.  Every variable in RENDER_ENV is removed before these are
#      applied, so the ambient environment of whoever runs the test cannot
#      quietly render a different pipeline than the row describes.
#   env_align       STREHL_ALIGN.  `0` = registration off.  `unset` = on.
#   env_warpmap     STREHL_WARPMAP.  A fixture file under tests/data, or `unset`.
#                   Setting it makes the row read a COMMITTED warp map and write
#                   nothing anywhere (merge_cmd.rs:1035).
#                   env_align=unset with env_warpmap=unset is a SOLVING row and is
#                   rejected by the parser, with the measurement, on sight.
#   env_fix_halo    STREHL_FIX_HALO, by value or `unset`.  (STREHL_FIX_HALO_DELTA
#                   is only read when this is set, and is cleared with it.)
#   env_cache_dir   STREHL_CACHE_DIR.  Must be `scratch`: the harness supplies an
#                   empty per-run directory.  The real default is a SHARED per-user
#                   cache, and a freeze that reads it is a freeze that depends on
#                   whatever another agent last solved on this machine.
#   alignment_mode  what the tool must REPORT on stderr for this row.  ASSERTED,
#                   before any hash is compared.  This column is the OBSERVATION;
#                   env_align/env_warpmap are the SETTING.  A silent flip of this
#                   field is exactly what M86c did.
#                   `on-sidecar-cache` is a legal observation and an ILLEGAL
#                   record -- see the parser.
#   sha256          uppercase hex, 64 chars.  Never truncated: the corpus already
#                   carries a freeze recorded as `D99F5D82...76CA`, which no
#                   machine can check.
#   bytes           expected file size.
#   workers         the chunking the baseline was measured under.  REPORTED, NOT
#                   ASSERTED -- it is a property of the measuring host (RAM and
#                   core count), and a mismatch here is the first thing to suspect
#                   when a hash moves on a machine that is not the one above.
#   baselined_at    the commit at which this row's hash was last measured.
#   baselined_on    YYYY-MM-DD.
#   why             WHY the hash is what it is, and what moved it last.  This is
#                   the column that would have prevented fact 1379.  It is checked
#                   for length and for placeholders; when you re-baseline a row,
#                   REWRITE IT.  A `why` describing the previous re-baseline is
#                   worse than an empty one, because it reads as current.
# ADDING A ROW: freezing everything is the same as freezing nothing.  See
# docs/research/M108-freeze-test.md section 5 for what earns a row and what
# does not.

column17: RE-BASELINED at 4c99cc40 (measurement), and the move is INTENDED. WHAT MOVED THEM: the FULL-RESOLUTION GATHER default flipped from off to on. warp_frame_in_place now dispatches to warp_frame_in_place_fullres, so every output pixel is gathered from a full-resolution demosaic of the frame instead of from its own half-resolution CFA phase plane, which had band-limited every phase to 0.25 cyc/output px BEFORE the election, where no later stage could recover it. WHY THE DEFAULT MOVED, all measured on real captures by instruments whose author did not write the path: band correlation at 0.25 cyc/out px 0.1514 -> 0.9329, and at 0.35 from NEGATIVE (-0.4965, inverted structure) to +0.4478; time 27.7->20.1 s (79 frames), 45.9->40.6 s (130), 110.3->97.1 s (299), i.e. 40-97 ms/frame FASTER against a prior analysis predicting +549 ms/frame slower; edge energy +6.3-15.7% on wrapped-text-1 and +6.8/+9.0% on bee-1-cpl with the local-envelope ring fraction flat or lower (1.086->1.053% strongest edge, 1.744->1.744% median). A DISAGREEMENT RECORDED AS OPEN, NOT RESOLVED: a step-normalised overshoot statistic reads the full-res arm as ringing MORE (0.179 vs 0.128/0.140), beyond its own 0.0122 byte-identical bound. The tie was broken by rendering both arms at 1:1 and LOOKING -- paper fibre inside flat white resolves on this path and is mush on the other, which sharpening cannot manufacture, and no bright rim appears on the dark side of any letterform, which sharpening would. The two statistics still disagree. ATTRIBUTION PROVEN BY ISOLATING THE VARIABLE, not by blaming a commit range, following the standard set at 2525e08, 96571ee and 6430fb2 -- necessary here because five files in crates/ were left modified by agents that died before committing, so a pin of any parent could not have separated this change from theirs. Re-rendering each row's OWN recorded invocation with the CURRENT binary and STREHL_FULLRES_GATHER=0 reproduces its standing baseline BIT-EXACTLY, and with it unset reproduces the value in this row bit-exactly (experiments/ORCH-drift-check/attribute_gather_freeze.py). That clears the five uncommitted files, and every commit since 6430fb2, of touching these bytes. ONLY THE SIDECAR ROW MOVED, AND THAT IS THE PREDICTED SIGNATURE, written from the call site BEFORE the render: fullres_gather_enabled() is read in exactly one place, warp_frame_in_place, which is warp application -- so the STREHL_ALIGN=0 row, where no warp runs and the flag is unreachable, MUST NOT move, and is a SPECIFICITY CONTROL rather than an inert arm. The registry itself predicted this in the 6430fb2 note, in advance and against itself: 'a change that moved only the sidecar row would have been in warp application and would not have been this one.' This is that change. The script fails on a violation in EITHER direction, so 'did not move' could not have been excused after the fact. CROSS-CHECKED: byte-freeze.rs measured the new sidecar hash independently and printed it as `actual` before the attribution script ran; the two instruments, which share no code, agree to the byte. FIXED WITH THIS BASELINE: STREHL_FULLRES_GATHER is now in RENDER_ENV and cleared before every render -- it selects what every output pixel is interpolated FROM, so an ambient value would render a different image than every row here claims. That omission is the STREHL_ALIGN=0 defect this file's header documents; it is registered in the same commit that gives it something to hide. A unit test now pins the polarity and makes an unrecognised value panic rather than fall back, so a silent flip back cannot happen without re-measuring. THIS ROW'S HASH IS UNCHANGED, and that is the result, not the absence of one: it is the specificity control described above, verified this run to reproduce bit-exactly under both arms.

column17: RE-BASELINED on 2026-08-28, MEASURED AT 6943f04b, and the move is INTENDED. WHAT MOVED IT: commit 393d7ca3 re-fitted the lateral chromatic-aberration coefficient eps_r from -704.5e-6 to -508.4e-6 (crates/strehl-core/src/optics.rs:461, pinned by a unit test at optics.rs:1541). The superseded -704.5e-6 OVER-CORRECTED: it left red displaced OUTWARD, past neutral and onto blue's side of every edge, on 6 of 6 stacks (+131.6..+255.5 ppm, median +192), which is the magenta rim visible at 1:1 in the delivered dry-erase-marker-head-cpl master. BLUE IS THE CONTROL for that fit -- same estimator, same tiles, same masters -- and it straddles zero at +18 ppm median, 2 negative and 4 positive, so a generic gain error in the instrument is refuted rather than assumed away. The new value is the median of six per-stack fits over 514 gated tiles, mean per-stack r2 0.9080, residual rms 0.0651 sensel, permutation p = 0.0005 (0 of 2000), mean leave-one-out error 71.7 ppm. WHY ONLY THIS ROW MOVED, derived from the call graph BEFORE anything was rendered: eps_r is read only by OpticalProfile::eps (optics.rs:278), whose only non-test consumers are OpticalProfile::compose (optics.rs:344) and displacement_at (optics.rs:388, which has no call site outside the test module). compose has exactly two call sites in the shipping binary -- align_cmd.rs:1929 in warp_frame_in_place_plane and align_cmd.rs:2095 in warp_frame_in_place_fullres -- and both are warp APPLICATION. A third call site exists at crates/strehl-cli/examples/build-demosaic-truth.rs:516; it is a separate cargo example target that the strehl binary does not link and that this test never runs, so it cannot reach these bytes. The CA correction is therefore reachable only where a warp is applied, and the STREHL_ALIGN=0 row coffee-bean-20-gate2-unaligned, where no warp runs, MUST NOT move: it is a SPECIFICITY CONTROL rather than an inert arm, and its holding is the result, not the absence of one. ATTRIBUTED BIT-EXACTLY, not by blaming a commit range, following the standard set at 2525e08, 6430fb2 and 4c99cc40: in an isolated copy of the source tree whose optics.rs was verified byte-identical to this one, setting eps_r back to -704.5e-6 and rebuilding makes THIS row reproduce the superseded baseline 52517FF8AE245F238C29F64A29E601C2D5C064CB4D86E93006512993837EC206 exactly, while the unaligned row holds at 88712017FE31362F35FF2FF5D4B98727CDEFCBAC489D9A7827F21EE0154A8620 unchanged. One constant accounts for every moved byte, in both directions, and the control is invariant to it under BOTH values rather than merely under one -- which no argument from the call graph alone could have established. THE TEETH WERE THEN PROVEN AGAINST THIS BASELINE, because re-baselining is the operation that can silently turn a freeze into a tautology: with the plant still in place and this row carrying the hash recorded here, the test FAILS and prints actual 52517FF8..., and restoring -508.4e-6 returns it to GREEN. Both transitions are recorded in docs/research/BUILD-GATE-PRINT.md section 2. bytes are unchanged at 49450019: the geometry did not move, only the pixel VALUES. Superseded value 52517FF8AE245F238C29F64A29E601C2D5C064CB4D86E93006512993837EC206 was the eps_r = -704.5e-6 baseline, recorded at 4c99cc40 on 2026-08-26.
